description: This is a Java test source file for the DefaultFailureHandler class, containing unit tests to verify error handling and response behaviors in a web server context using Vert.x framework.

classes.name: DefaultFailureHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class verifying behaviors of DefaultFailureHandler, focusing on HTTP response handling for different failure scenarios.

methods.name: testHandlerDetectsEndedResponse
methods.description: Tests that the handler does not modify response if response is already ended.

methods.name: testHandlerSucceedsForExceptionsWithoutMessage
methods.description: Tests that the handler responds with an Internal Server Error when failure has no detailed message.

methods.name: testHandlerWritesDetailMessageToBody
methods.description: Verifies that the handler writes the failure's detail message into the response body.

methods.name: testHandlerWritesDetailMessageAndErrorCodeToBody
methods.description: Checks that the handler writes both the error message and sets appropriate status code for ClientErrorException.

methods.name: testHandlerWithFailedContextAndEmptyFailure
methods.description: Verifies response behavior when failure is null, ensuring status code and response end are handled properly.
